coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 6 of 11 ground-truth items (55%): the FP16 versus QuaRot 4-bit comparison and all five dependent variables, including relative timing improvement as a speedup measure.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The design varies model size across 7B and 13B rather than holding the specified 7B architecture constant, and replaces e2e/benchmark.py methodology with a custom protocol. Batch size and prefill length are swept rather than fixed at 1 and 2048; decoding uses other lengths instead of 32 steps. Including some target values within broader sweeps does not reproduce the specified settings.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the expected performance comparison.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: No conclusion reports comparative prefill time, decoding time, memory usage, or per-phase speedup for QuaRot 4-bit versus FP16.
